candidates.title: Psalms 13 (How Long O Lord) - Brian Doerksen

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: How long, oh Lord,
will you forget me?
How long, oh Lord?
Will you look the other way?
How long?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: How long, oh Lord, will you forget me?
How long, oh Lord, will you look the other way? How long,
oh Lord, must I wrestle with my thoughts? and
every day have such sorrow in my heart.
Look on me and answer, oh God, my father,
bring light to my darkness before they see me fall.
Oh Lord,

to me.
